title: Think Before You Act: A Two-Stage Framework for Mitigating Gender Bias Towards Vision-Language Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating gender misclassification ratio (Error), gender bias amplification in generated contexts (LIC), and word-gender co-occurrence amplification (BiasAmp) in image captioning. For image search, measuring the distribution and skew of retrieved masculine and feminine images using Bias@K, MaxSkew@K, and NDKL. Additionally, assessing pronoun resolution accuracy gaps on the VisoGender benchmark and measuring vision-language bias via counterfactual gender word swapping on the VL-Bias dataset.
